definitions.explanation: The deepest underlying layer or foundation of something abstract, such as a belief system, culture, or way of thinking. Emphasizes what lies at the very bottom, supporting everything above it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{根底|こんてい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Trust lies at the foundation of the relationship.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{考|かんが}え→考え：00855_kangae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{根底|こんてい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}るがす→揺るがす：12936_yurugasu⟧。
examples.english: That idea shakes the very foundations of society.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{根底|こんてい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧⟦{愛情|あいじょう}→愛情：01673_aijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Deep love for his family lies at the root of his actions.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {根底|こんてい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to lie at the foundation of
- {根底|こんてい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{覆|くつがえ}す→覆す：07568_kutsugaesu⟧: to overturn from the foundations
- {根底|こんてい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}るがす→揺るがす：12936_yurugasu⟧: to shake the very foundations
- {根底|こんてい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{崩|くず}れる→崩れる：04248_kuzureru⟧: to collapse from the base

USAGE:
{根底|こんてい} is almost always used for abstract things — beliefs, relationships, systems, cultures. The most characteristic pattern is {根底|こんてい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to underlie), describing what exists at the deepest level.

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{根本|こんぽん}→根本：13107_konpon⟧ focuses on the fundamental origin or cause. {根底|こんてい} emphasizes the deepest underlying layer that supports everything above it.
